editors.notes: Accounting integrations are a paid-plan feature (POS Plus / Payments Plus) and country-gated: UK+IE list Sage Accounting, Xero, QuickBooks; DE lists DATEV + sevdesk; AT lists sevdesk only. No such article for FR, IT, ES, NL, BE, PT (404). FR marketing page says Caisse Plus 'integrates with main accounting software' without naming any. POS Pro (ex-Tiller) offers a generic CSV/PDF accounting report and, in DE, a DATEV-format file export (SKR03). editors.notes: Three layers. (1) Native 'Lightspeed Accounting': QuickBooks Online/Desktop, Xero, Sage Business Cloud Accounting (K-Series doc calls it 'Sage One'), Exact Online, DATEV (DE only), MYOB (AU); K-Series Accounting 3.0 is 'enabled via Omniboost' for Xero/QuickBooks Online/MYOB. (2) Marketplace connectors by third parties: Omniboost (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, SAP Business One, Twinfield, Sage BOB, Yuki, Bexio, also Exact Online and QuickBooks), winkelboekhouding.nl / webwinkelfacturen.nl (NL/BE packages), Scrada (BE), Shogo and POS Accounting (QuickBooks/Xero, US/UK). (3) Chift is listed on FR and UK marketplaces (K-Series): FR page names Pennylane, MyUnisoft, Sage; UK page names Sage, Cegid, Pennylane, Inqom, MyUnisoft. Lists differ strongly by country site: FR accounting = Pennylane, NetSuite, Chift, Exact Online, QuickBooks, Azopio, OuiLink; DE = DATEV, Bexio via Omniboost, PINIT (the DE 'Sage' card is payroll, not accounting); BE-FR page lists only Blent under accounting; ES page has no accounting integration. Not found: Cegid product names (Loop/Quadra/Expert), ACD, EBP, Fulll, Tiime, Isacompta, Indy, Lexware Office, sevdesk, Addison, Agenda, Scopevisio, BuchhaltungsButler, WinBooks, Odoo, Holded, a3, FreeAgent, KashFlow, Italian packages, Business Central. X-Series help centre blocked (403).

editors.notes: Integrations are invoice-collection apps (direct debit / pay by bank triggered from the accounting tool, with automatic reconciliation), mostly built with or by the software vendor. Two coexisting public directories: new /integrations (350+ claimed, 55 pages indexed, accounting ones: Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, FreeAgent, KashFlow, QuickFile, Zoho) and legacy localized /partners directories (EN, FR, DE, ES) which carry country-specific names: FR = Pennylane, EBP Facturation, Evoliz, Sellsy, Axonaut, Altoviz, Factomos, Isoftis, Sage Intacct, Sage 50cloud; DE = Lexware Office (via SepaHeld), PayJoe; ES = Xero, Zoho, Billin (Holded only named in menu text). Other accounting-category partners not listed as rows: Fiskl, hibooks, Tide, Kolleno, Upflow, Agicap. Not found: Cegid, Sage 100, ACD, MyUnisoft, Inqom, Fulll, Tiime, DATEV, sevdesk, Exact Online, Twinfield, Moneybird, WinBooks, Yuki, a3, Italian packages, SAP. No Chift/Codat mention.

editors.notes: Key point for Chift: the Track product page states 'Connectez Payplug à votre ERP pour envoyer automatiquement les données de paiement via Chift' (FR, EN and IT versions), without naming any target software, so no row was created for it. The modules page section 'ERP et outils comptables' lists EBP, Divalto, Evoliz, Agicap, Nout, ProGBat: these are payment-link-in-invoice integrations, not accounting-entry sync. Support article additionally lists Dougs, Fygr, Pennylane and Budget Insight ('remontées comptables sur de nombreuses solutions'). Otherwise accounting relies on generic CSV exports from the portal. Cegid appears only as a POS (retail) partner; Axonaut as a partner testimonial. Not found: Sage, Cegid accounting products, ACD, MyUnisoft, Inqom, Fulll, Tiime, Indy, QuickBooks, Xero, DATEV, Italian packages (IT modules page has no ERP section).
